scripts.start: concurrently --names backend,frontend "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix frontend start"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.lint: eslint eslint.config.cjs .github/scripts backend/src backend/tests frontend/src frontend/vitest-base.config.mts --max-warnings=0
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend run test:ci
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix backend run test:coverage && npm --prefix frontend run test:coverage
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run test:ci-workflow && npm run build && npm run test:coverage
